author: Richard Li
description: I was hoping "XCOM but Star Wars" would have been a little bit more than just Star Wars painted over XCOM.
title: Star Wars Zero Company Is Good But Seems To Play Things Too Safe – Preview

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Elder Scrolls 6 is one of Microsoft's biggest upcoming games, but it remains largely a mystery, despite being announced more than eight years ago. Today, August 11, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma provided an update on it, saying she witnessed a "live playthrough" of the game. She also teased the game's subtitle, or at least that's what it seems like.

"The scale and grandeur are incredible. The story is even gre
title: The Elder Scrolls 6 Might Have An 8-Letter Subtitle

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The head of No Man's Sky developer Hello Games, Sean Murray, has said it would be a bad idea for his mental health to think about how much money the studio could have made by charging for the game's various expansions or by selling microtransactions.

"I'm sure somebody could take me aside, take me into a room and show me some PowerPoint and show me that we could have made more money if we had done in-app purchase or, you know, if we had done DLC or something like that," Murray told GamesRadar. "'And maybe that would be true. I never want to see that PowerPoi
title: No Man’s Sky Could Have Made So Much Money From DLC And Microtransactions, Sean Murray Says

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
EA and Battlefield Studios have released a new trailer for Battlefield 6 that shows off the upcoming fan-favorite map Wake Island, which arrives on August 18 alongside a Top Gun-themed crossover event.

Wake Island, which first appeared in Battlefield 1942, is inspired by the real-life Wake Atoll in the Pacific ocean where a World War II battle took place, and it's among the most beloved Battlefield maps ever.

The newest version of the map for Battlefield 6 looks pretty incredible, at least based on the newly released gameplay footage.
title: Battlefield 6 Trailer Shows Off New Version Of Wake Island, And It Looks Incredible

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Halo Campaign Evolved is a celebration of the franchise, but not many people are attending that party. New estimates peg sales at 1.2 million copies sold across PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5 so far, around $67 million in revenue, which isn't the best start for this remake of the original Halo campaign. Also available via Xbox Game Pass, the game is estimated to have 2.1 million players through the subscription service.

According to Alinea Analytics' head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, there are several reasons for this. Sales are split almost down the middle between Xbox Series X|S and PS5 at 42% and 41%, respectively, while Steam accounts for 17% of sales. This is up from i
title: Halo: Campaign Evolved’s Biggest Competition Might Be Halo

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Out of nowhere, the Embracer-owned Aspyr Media announced and released a new edition of The Lord of the Rings: War in the North today across PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC.

The game was originally released in 2011 for PS3, Xbox 360, Switch 2, and PC, but now it's available on the latest generation of consoles for $20 (or $18 through August 25) as part of a "Legacy" edition. The new version features online or local split-screen co-op and "optimized" solo play, though further specifics about the updates and upgrades were not detailed.

War in the North was originally developed by Snowblind Studios, which closed in 2012. The game takes place in Middle-earth,
title: 2011 The Lord Of The Rings Game Gets Surprise Re-Release Today

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Nintendo might be preparing for a 40th celebration of The Legend of Zelda series, with Switch 2 possibly getting its first special-edition system based on the beloved franchise. A new leak on social media shows a Triforce decked-out Switch 2 dock, with what appears to be black and green Joy-Con 2 controllers decorated with flourishes of gold. 

The Centro LEAKS account on X posted two purported pictures of the Zelda-themed Switch 2 and Switch 2 Pro Controllers. Nintendo hasn't released any official statements about a new system or controller--let alone anything about a Zelda 40th-anniversary event. However, it's been common in the past for the company to bring out special Zelda consoles for new games in the franchise, such as the Tears of the Kingdom OL
title: First Switch 2 Special Edition Might Celebrate Zelda’s 40th Anniversary, If Leaks Are Hy-Real

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
There is no stopping Sony's all-digital future for video games. I don't mean to sound pessimistic, but the company's decision to kill off physical game discs in 2028 and effectively turn the PlayStation Store into the only place in town where you can grab a new PS5 title won't be stopped by an endless barrage of memes in the replies section. Like Thanos preparing to snap the universe into a 50% discount on life, it's inevitable.

Sony has said as much in recent
title: Sony’s All-Digital PlayStation Future Needs A Little More Steam

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The recent Mortal Kombat movies have been hailed for adapting the bloody fighting games to the big screen, but will the duology ever become a trilogy? Simon McQuoid--the director of the two movies--isn't so sure, as he's currently focused on a very different project.

When quizzed by The Wrap on the topic of Mortal Kombat 3, McQuoid diplomatically replied that he wasn't sure yet if a threequel would be made, but he was open to the idea. "I think it's still going through its life cycle. So I don’t know yet. I'm not sure," McQuoid said. "I feel like there are other stories that I want to tell that aren't necessarily in Mortal Kombat, and I have multiple things in development, one of which we're just casting now, and that's not Mortal Kombat at all--something that is in the real world and very much a deep dive into a sin
title: Mortal Kombat 3 Isn’t Off The Table, But Its Director Is Busy With A Very Different Movie

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Supermassive Games has announced job cuts for "up to 75" people--marking the third straight year of significant layoffs at the studio. This latest round of reductions comes almost three months after the release of Directive 8020, the newest entry in The Dark Pictures horror anthology.

In a statement on X, Supermassive noted the firings were "a necessary step to help ensure the sustainability of the company." That's not the first time the Until Dawn developer has cited "sustainability" after layoffs, either. In 2024, there were reportedly 90 employees let go, with up to 150 positions at risk. Supermassive pointed to "continued sustainability of the company" in regard to those cuts. Th
title: Third Straight Year Of Layoffs Hits Until Dawn, Little Nightmares 3 Dev Supermassive

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Take-Two, which owns Rockstar and Grand Theft Auto, is not interested in selling. The company's top boss, Strauss Zelnick, appeared on CNBC recently where he was asked if Take-Two's partnership with Netflix for the next GTA 6 trailer might be the first step toward a buyout. It is not, he said, adding that Take-Two is not interested in selling to anyone at the moment.

Zelnick pointed out that Take-Two has already "made a bunch of deals" with Netflix for distributin
title: GTA 6 Owner Take-Two Is Not Interested In Selling To Netflix Or Anyone Right Now

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Job Simulator has long been one of the best reasons to own a VR headset, and it might be bringing the glory days of working behind a counter--or cubicle hell--to a flat screen near you. Homeworld: Vast Reaches developer FarBridge has announced Job Simulator: Human Relations, which will see up to four players work together to complete tasks during their virtual eight-hour shift, like competing for resources or surviving natural disasters to appease their robot overlords. While you won't be playing as squishy humans in this co-op chaos game, you will be piloting several robots attempting to navigate the human workplace.

The project is seeking crowdfunding to help make it a reality, as FarBridge has launched a Kickstarter campaign for it. If the studio successfully raises $150,000, the funds will be used to support the game's de
title: Job Simulator Is Finally Giving Your VR Headset The Day Off

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Marvel's Wolverine launches next month, and to celebrate, Sony has revealed a new limited-edition PS5 console and controller design inspired by the game. Dubbed the Marvel’s Wolverine Battle Yellow Limited Edition Bundle and priced at $650, fans of the Marvel mutant can choose between a PS5 Digital Edition that comes with both a matching DualSense wireless controller and a download code for the game, or they can pick up the $75 console covers for their base model PS5 and the PS5 Pro. Sony says that these will be available through the PlayStation Direct store, as well as through select retailers starting September 15, the same day that Marvel's Wolverine launches.
title: Marvel’s Wolverine Has Given Us Sony’s Best-Looking PS5 Ever

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Modern Warfare 4's first beta session arrives next week to let players get hands-on time with this year's new game. Call of Duty betas typically only include multiplayer content, but the official social media account is hinting at a potential Warzone Resurgence map for beta testing as well. 

The latest episode of Infinity Ward's "From The Ward" docuseries was geared toward the new Kill Block multiplayer map shown at Fanatics Fest, but fans have spotted a teaser for an upcoming Warzone Resurgence map with the codename "Zodiac." As players questioned online when this map could potentially get announced, an official Call of Duty account replied by saying, "Find out in....beta?"
title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 Beta May Include A New Warzone Map

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's long-awaited open-world crime game Grand Theft Auto 6 releases in exactly 100 days, on November 19. Despite the game launching relatively soon, Rockstar has yet to actually say much about what to expect in terms of gameplay specifics, story details, what's happening with GTA Online, and basically everything else. There have been two trailers thus far, and they've offered a tantalizing look at the game's world and characters, but that's all we've gotten.

Rockstar staying quiet is no doubt by design, to help further ratchet up hype and intrigue. But the floodgates are primed to open on August 27, which is when Rockstar will
title: GTA 6 Is 100 Days Away, And We Have 100 Questions

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for the standard edition, but if you're a student who shops at Target and you meet certain eligibility requirements, you can potentially get the game for a nice discount.

Target Circle Students members can save 20% on the game's code-in-the-box version, bringing it down to $64 before taxes. Buying the game now via preordering also gets you perks like the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free month of GTA+. The deal was spotted by Wario64.
title: How Students Can Get GTA 6 For $64

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Last week's announcement of the Uber-like Ride Stimulator might have flown under your radar, but in case you missed it, you also missed out on a not-so-subtle dig at Gearbox CEO Randy Pitchford. According to Saber Interactive boss Matt Karch, the company is publishing the game. The reveal trailer for the game does indeed include a dig at Pitchford's infamous flash drive incident and his passion for stage magic.

At one point in the trailer, you can see a car license plate with "USB DRV" on it, alongside a reference to the US state of Texas. A voiceover in the trailer also mentions having met "the randiest of passengers" and taking passengers to a "castle" in tow
title: Saber Interactive’s New Taxi Game Is Beefing With Randy Pitchford

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has acknowledged that the company could have charged more for Grand Theft Auto 6, but it declined to do so to ensure pricing felt fair. He also shared new insight into how GTA 6 preorders are going so far, saying they're skewing toward the $100 edition early on.
title: GTA 6 Could Have Had An Even Higher Price, As $100 Edition Proves Popular

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Final Fantasy Resonance is the first game in the franchise to get the HD-2D treatment, as this new spin-off based on Final Fantasy Brave Exvius translates the mobile title into a PC and console adventure. It also looks like two of the best parts of the game will be coming along for the ride: guest characters from other Final Fantasy games and their impressive CG-animated ultimate attacks. It's also kind of funny to see Cloud in action, as the previous trailer for the game asked viewers to imagine a world where Final Fantasy 7 didn't change the course of the franchise with its advanced 3D graphics.

In a new trailer, Square Enix showed off how players will be able to call upon the power of Visions, heroes from other worlds and timelines. Final Fantasy 7's st
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Is Inheriting Two Of Brave Exvius’ Coolest Features, Minus The Gacha

author: Callum Self
description:
I’m a sucker for Monster Hunter World, and I really enjoyed Wilds, but Monster Hunter Rise holds a special place in my monster-hunting, forever-grinding heart. The faster pace makes every hunt feel just slightly more chaotic, yet way more fun, and the excellent Sunbreak DLC only expands the roster of hunts with some more challenging elements, too. If you haven’t given it a chance, now is the best time, as Monster Hunter Rise and Sunbreak are available at their lowest price ever.

When it comes to the best RPGs, the usual suspects appear. Skyrim? Sure. Maybe even a dash of Fallout, too. Persona? Absolutely. Final Fantasy VII? Definitely. However, the Monster Hunter series’ focus on action typically leaves the games out of the running, and I think that’s wrong. Monster Hunter Rise is one of
title: The Best Monster Hunter Game Is 86% Off Right Now

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
While many game studios chase the elusive idea of a "forever game," Bandai Namco cracked the formula a decade ago with Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2. Pitting fan-favorite characters from the franchise against custom-made warriors, Xenoverse 2 had an extraordinarily long run following its release in 2015, as constant updates and new story content kept the experience fresh for years. A decade later, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 is aiming to move the series forward.

Following teasers for "Age 1,000" and the subsequent unveiling of Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 earlier this year, publisher Bandai Namco has begun to steadily reveal more details about the action-RPG, its new gameplay mechanics, and where it fits into the Dragon Ball timeline. If you haven't been keeping up, then here's a closer look at everything that has been revealed so
title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 – Release Date, Gameplay, And Everything We Know
